faq.question: How do I convert a Markdown file to HTML?
faq.answer: Upload your .md file and download the standalone HTML5 document immediately.

faq.question: What happens to raw HTML inside my Markdown?
faq.answer: Raw HTML blocks in the Markdown are passed through to the rendered HTML verbatim in this MVP (the python-markdown default). Do not upload Markdown from untrusted sources if you do not want its HTML re-emitted; the output is served as a file download, not executed on our servers.

faq.question: Is the conversion secure?
faq.answer: Yes, files are processed securely on our servers and automatically deleted after conversion.

faq.question: Is the conversion secure for untrusted Markdown?
faq.answer: This MVP renders Markdown without an HTML sanitizer: embedded raw HTML reappears unchanged in the output file. Treat the download like any untrusted HTML file.
